verdict.line: You lose trades and risk a solo kill before level 6 if you fight her near a wall with live tentacles, but Trinity Force plus Ravenous Hydra kiting from level 9 on turns this into an even-to-favoured skirmish lane.

brief.thesis: Illaoi's damage is gated by tentacles spawned on nearby walls and by her passive lifesteal off them, not by her own kit alone — so the lane is decided by whether you fight inside her tentacle radius or outside it. Camille has no tool to remove tentacles quickly and no sustained DPS to out-trade a tentacle-fed Illaoi, which is why the measured data (48% win rate, 621 games) has Illaoi favoured with a solo-kill edge despite Camille's overall 50.5% class win rate.

theirWindow.when: E lands on you near a tentacle
theirWindow.what: Once Test of Spirit (E, 16/15/14/13/12s cd, range 900) rips your spirit and a tentacle is close enough to swing at the projected spirit, the echoed damage on you doubles up fast — disengage immediately rather than trading through it, and never let this happen while also eating Harsh Lesson (W, 4s cd, range 400) resets.

yourWindow.when: tentacles dead and E on cooldown
yourWindow.what: With no tentacle to feed her passive heal and Test of Spirit unavailable, Illaoi has only Q (Tentacle Smash, 10-6s cd) and W (Harsh Lesson) left — this is when your Q (Precision Protocol) delayed recast and W (Tactical Sweep) poke actually win the exchange.

start.why: The 72%-pick, 48%-win start over 529 games — the extra sustain and damage matter because you need to survive to your item spikes rather than win level 1-5 trades outright.

boots.why: 75.8% pick, 47% win rate — Illaoi's damage is entirely physical autos and Tentacle Smash procs, so the flat physical reduction directly blunts her trade pattern.

core.why: First item in the 55%-win, 39.9%-pick path — the move speed and empowered auto pair with Q (Precision Protocol) to let you land poke and leave before her W (Harsh Lesson) resets.
Second item in the same path — sustain to outlast tentacle chip damage and cleave for wave clear so she can't freely stack Test of Spirit vessels on minions.
Most-picked third item (55% win, 39.9% pick) — bleeds damage over time so her burst windows (E echo, R zone) don't one-shot you out of a fight you're winning on tempo.

situational.when: she is snowballing off tentacle passive heal or Harsh Lesson sustain
the game is going long and you need cooldown reduction to out-tempo her W and Q
she is landing Test of Spirit reliably and you need burst survivability over pure damage
the enemy team has a second heavy-CC or magic threat beyond Illaoi herself

runes.keystoneWhy: The higher-performing page (50% win, 621-game matchup) — Grasp's proc and max-health scaling directly counter the passive-heal, tentacle-chip war of attrition Illaoi wants to fight.

summoners.why: The most-picked combo (69.9% pick) — Flash gets you out of Test of Spirit range before the echo stacks, and Ignite directly answers OP.GG's own read on this matchup: buy into reducing her tentacle/passive healing.

playing.title: Clear tentacles before you commit
playing.detail: Never start a trade while a live tentacle is in range — it free-hits you and heals Illaoi off her passive. Use Q (Precision Protocol) or W (Tactical Sweep) to knock it down first.

playing.title: Track Test of Spirit, not just her HP
playing.detail: Test of Spirit (E, 16-12s cd, range 900) is her all-in button. If she has it up and you're near a tentacle, disengage — the spirit echo plus tentacle swing can double-punish you in one exchange.

playing.title: Hookshot away from her tentacle walls
playing.detail: E (Hookshot, range 800) is your reset, but landing on a wall she's already tentacled just feeds her more free damage on the way down — pick a clean wall or use it purely to disengage.

playing.title: Poke, don't brawl
playing.detail: Delay your Q (Precision Protocol) recast for the bonus damage window, land it, and back off. Harsh Lesson (W, 4s cd) means she resets pressure faster than you can out-trade her in extended melee.

playing.title: Cap trades at two or three exchanges
playing.detail: Her 4-second W cooldown lets her re-engage constantly; sustained fights favor her passive sustain, not you.

playing.title: Save R for isolating her off tentacles
playing.detail: The Hextech Ultimatum (R, range 475) is best used in river or jungle brawls where no tentacle is nearby to punish the anchor, not inside her lane's tentacle-covered walls.

playing.title: Buy healing reduction the moment she snowballs
playing.detail: If tentacle sustain is keeping her topped up through your poke, prioritize Executioner's Calling immediately rather than finishing your core first.

brief.patchCaveat: The build, runes, summoners, and every number above are measured OP.GG data from live games on the current patch (16.18.1); the mechanical reasoning about tentacles, Test of Spirit timing, and trade windows is the author's own tactical analysis.
